5607.about: A field of dry golden grass after a battle lies under dark storm clouds. Round wooden shields with metal centres are scattered everywhere, arrows stick up out of the ground and a torn red banner flutters on a leaning pole. A saddled chestnut horse with no rider grazes in the middle, lifts its head to look around and then lowers it to graze again. On the right a wooden cart burns with orange flames and grey smoke. Beyond a low stone wall a stone castle with square towers stands on a rocky hill.
5607.question: What is the horse doing?
5607.answer: The horse is grazing on the battlefield.

5608.about: In an indoor swimming pool with tall sunlit windows, the view starts close on the bare feet and legs of a young woman standing on a diving board and pulls back to show her whole body. She has short bleached hair and a grey swimsuit. She bends her knees, swings her arms back, then straightens and spreads her arms, ready to jump, at the very end of the board. Wet footprints mark the board, and far below a coach in black and swimmers at the edge look up from the blue water with red and white lane ropes.
5608.question: What is the diver about to do?
5608.answer: She is about to dive into the pool.

5610.about: In an elegant living room with dark green patterned wallpaper, a white marble fireplace, a gold-framed landscape painting and glowing wall lamps, a smiling young woman in a burgundy jumper and cream trousers sits on a green velvet sofa. A golden cocker spaniel jumps up onto the sofa beside her, walks along the cushions, turns and lies down next to her, and she strokes its head. A mustard throw hangs off the arm, and a side table by the window holds a cup of tea and an open book.

phrases.en: to lie down next to her

5610.question: What is the woman doing?

5613.about: On an outdoor sports court with high green walls, a fence and old stone arches, a young woman with a long braid, in a rust sports top, films herself up close, grinning widely, and then points her thumb back over her shoulder. Behind her a young woman in a black sports top and grey shorts holds a huge rough boulder on her shoulder with both hands, straining under its weight. Wooden benches with towels stand under the arches, and a straw mat lies on the ground.
5613.question: What is the woman in black carrying?
5613.answer: She is carrying a boulder on her shoulder.

5614.about: In a bright office lobby with a glass roof, a white marble floor, large potted fig trees and a revolving door, three people in plain black suits walk in a line holding takeaway coffee cups. Among them a young woman with a high blonde ponytail, in a bright yellow suit, yellow top and white trainers, walks along smiling, sips from a green drink and carries a yellow bag, moving ahead of the others towards the front. A reception desk with white lilies stands nearby, and sunlight streams in.
5614.question: What is the woman in yellow wearing?
5614.answer: She is wearing a yellow suit.

5615.about: At night under rows of red paper lanterns, a smiling young cook in a white headband, white t-shirt and black apron tosses a big bunch of noodles with peppers high into the air from a wok over a bright blue gas flame. The noodles fall back into the wok, he stirs them and then lifts a long bunch up high again. Behind him a crowd holding bowls cheers and films him. Next to him a young woman in a mustard top ladles soup into paper cups beside stacked bamboo steamers.

phrases.en: to throw noodles into the air
to cook noodles in a pan

5615.question: What is the cook doing?
5615.answer: He is cooking noodles in a pan.

5617.about: In a woodworking workshop with sunlight coming through a high window, a bearded man in a grey shirt and a worn canvas apron strikes a chisel with a wooden mallet and cuts a neat curl of wood from a beam on the workbench. He then leans in, lifts the chisel up and looks at its edge with a satisfied grin. Wood shavings and a neat row of chisels lie on the bench. Behind him four young men lean on their benches and watch closely. Saws and tools hang on the wall.
5617.question: What is the bearded man doing?

5618.about: On a rooftop terrace in warm evening sun, with olive trees in planters, wooden benches and red brick rooftops behind, a young woman in a blue satin slip dress and white trainers lifts a laughing friend in a cream top and wide trousers off the ground and swings her round in a hug. She sets her friend down, and they keep hugging and laughing. In front, seated friends clap, and one pours iced coffee from a glass jug into cups on a low table.
5618.question: What is the woman in blue doing?
5618.answer: She is lifting her friend off the ground.

5619.about: In a busy restaurant kitchen with white tiles, copper pans hanging above the stove, brass lamps and a red and cream checked floor, a young woman head chef in a white jacket and burgundy neckerchief raises one hand and calls out, her other hand on a plate at the pass. A long row of plates of roast chicken and green beans waits in front of her. Two cooks in navy aprons work at the stove behind her, and then a young cook in a navy apron steps in and sets down another plate beside her.

phrases.en: to flip food in a pan

5619.question: What is the head chef doing?
5619.answer: She is raising her arm high.

5620.about: On a city street at night in the rain, in front of a noodle shop window and a glowing neon restaurant sign, a laughing young woman in a red coat jumps into the arms of a young man in a black jumper and jeans. He holds her tight and spins her round, then sets her down. He takes her face in his hands, they smile at each other, and they rest their foreheads together, their hair wet from the rain. The wet pavement reflects pink and blue light.
5620.question: What is the woman wearing?
5620.answer: She is wearing a red coat.

5621.about: In a living room at dusk lit by a single floor lamp, a young man in a dark suit tiptoes across the rug in his socks, carrying his shoes in one hand. He stops and gives an awkward, guilty grin. A young woman in a cream jumper sits in an armchair with her arms crossed and a stern face, watching him, and a scruffy brown dog sits beside her chair and also stares at him. A grey sofa, framed prints and a coffee table are in the room.
5621.question: What is the woman doing?
5621.answer: She is sitting with folded arms.

5622.about: On a sandy beach at night under a sky full of stars and the Milky Way, with the dark sea behind, a young woman with curly hair, in a white zip hoodie and denim shorts, bends to look through a telescope on a tripod, laughing with excitement and tugging at a young man's arm. He stands barefoot in a navy polo and cream trousers, yawns widely, drops his arms, then crosses them again and stares up with a bored face. A glowing lantern and a flask sit on a blanket on the sand.
5622.question: What is the woman looking through?
5622.answer: She is looking through a telescope.

5623.about: At a bright record fair in a hall with tall windows, a young woman with long dark curls, in an olive jacket, beige knit top and jeans, kneels by wooden crates full of vinyl records with a thick stack under one arm. She eagerly lifts a record with an orange label in a crate, then lets go of it and hugs her stack of records to her chest. A chalkboard price sign stands on the crates. Behind her people browse the stalls: a man with headphones, a stallholder with a box and a young man lowering his raised arm.

phrases.en: to clutch a stack of records
to rummage in a cardboard box

5623.question: What is the woman holding?
5623.answer: She is clutching a stack of records.

5624.about: In an old cafe with an arched doorway, patterned floor tiles, carved wooden panels, a hanging lantern and a ceiling fan, a smiling young man in a rust shirt and cream trousers stands in the middle with a grey parrot with a red tail on his shoulder. Seated men holding small glasses of mint tea laugh and point at him. The parrot spreads its wings, and the young man bends his head down, laughing. A marble table with a glass of mint tea stands in front.

phrases.target: the man in the white shirt

phrases.en: to point at the standing man
phrases.target: the man in the dark jumper

5624.question: Where is the parrot perching?
5624.answer: It is perching on the man's shoulder.

5625.about: On a sunny tropical beach, a young man in a white office shirt with a loose navy tie and light blue swim shorts lies barefoot in a white rope hammock between palm trees, smiling and drinking from a green coconut with a straw. He then leans his head back, closes his eyes and relaxes. A blue suitcase stands by a palm trunk, and a brown dog sleeps on the sand below him. Behind is a colourful wooden beach bar with string lights and hanging coconuts, and turquoise sea.
5625.question: What is the man doing?
5625.answer: He is lying in a hammock.

5627.about: In a small shop with tall wooden shelves packed with jars of jam and tins, a brass lamp and a brass ladder, there is an empty gap in the middle of one shelf where the jars have run out, and a grey cat lies curled up in it. A hand in a rust knitted sleeve with a silver bracelet reaches up towards the gap. The cat wakes, yawns widely and settles down again, and the hand moves down to the jars on the shelf below. Small brown mosaic tiles cover the wall under the shelves.

phrases.en: to curl up on a shelf
to reach up towards the cat

5627.question: Where is the cat lying?
5627.answer: It is lying in a gap between the jars.

5628.about: In an empty roller-skating hall after a party, a young man in a blue padded vest, white T-shirt and black trousers smiles as he pushes a wide broom through a big pile of pink, gold and silver confetti and burst balloons on the wooden floor. Pink and silver balloons lie scattered around. Behind him a young blonde woman in a lilac top sits on a bench taking off her white roller skates and then stands up. A mirror disco ball hangs from the black ceiling, and pink and teal neon lights glow on the walls.
5628.question: What is the man doing?

5630.about: On a stone farmhouse terrace at sunset, a young woman in a pink wrap top and a cream midi skirt carefully carries a tall three-tier white cake decorated with pink roses on both hands, lifting one foot as a shaggy brown and white dog crouches playfully at her feet. She puts her foot down and stands still, smiling, while the dog sits and looks up at the cake. Behind her two young women in blue and lilac slip dresses dance under a vine pergola hung with string lights.
5630.question: What is the woman in cream carrying?
5630.answer: She is carrying a tiered cake.

5631.about: On a rooftop terrace in the evening, two young women who look almost exactly the same stand side by side, laughing and pointing at each other: both have long dark wavy hair, gold hoop earrings, dark green satin slip dresses and gold sandals. They lean together laughing, then turn to each other and hug. String lights hang overhead. Around them are a wicker daybed with patterned cushions, a carved wooden door, a green balustrade and patterned tiles, with city towers under a deep blue sky.
5631.question: What are the two women doing?
5631.answer: They are pointing at each other.

5632.about: On a sunny rooftop deck, a young man in a white vest and cream shorts lies in a rope hammock with his eyes closed, holding a small brown dog on his chest. Behind him, by the wooden fence, a paint tin stands on a stool, and a young woman in a red zip jacket, white crop top and denim shorts stands with her hands on her hips, frowning down at him. He opens his eyes, grins, and pulls a cap down over his face, and she throws up one hand in frustration. String lights hang above.

phrases.en: to curl up on his chest

5632.question: Where is the man lounging?
5632.answer: He is lounging in a rope hammock.

5633.about: At a harbour at dusk in the rain, under a green wooden shelter with a corrugated roof and a glowing lamp, a young woman in a burgundy jumper and wide black trousers leans over and pulls a navy rain jacket over the head of a young man in a white T-shirt who sits on a bench looking down. She settles the jacket round his shoulders, he looks up and smiles at her, and she rests her head against his. A broken umbrella lies inside out on the wet ground, and a black dog sits beside him.

phrases.en: to drape a jacket over him
to sit hunched on a bench

5633.question: What is the woman doing?
5633.answer: She is draping a jacket over him.

5634.about: In a tall mirror in an attic bedroom, a young woman in a long burgundy wool coat, cream top and black trousers holds up a phone with keys in her other hand and stares at it with a flat, fed-up face. Behind her a young man wrapped in a white towel kneels at a pink chest of drawers, digging through clothes and pulling out a shirt, while more clothes lie in a heap on the wooden floor. A grey dog stands on the white bed. The room has dark wooden walls, beams, a candle chandelier and a window onto a harbour.
5634.question: What is the man doing?
5634.answer: He is rummaging through a drawer.

5635.about: In a grand gilded hall with a painted ceiling and a huge crystal chandelier, a young chef in a white jacket, her hair in a bun, stands behind a table with a white cloth and carefully adds a piece to a tall pink and gold cake built from sugar shards. Three judges lean in close to inspect it: a woman in a burgundy blazer, a young man in a navy suit who straightens up with a serious look, and a woman in a green dress. A trolley stands on the patterned parquet floor.

phrases.en: to hang from the painted ceiling

5635.question: What is the chef doing?
5635.answer: She is placing a sugar shard on the cake.

5637.about: In a small apartment kitchen, a blue passenger train rushes past right outside the tall window, blurred with speed and filling the whole window. A young woman in a green top and black leggings stands barefoot by the counter holding a phone and a mug, turns, and stares at the train with her mouth open. At a small table a bearded young man in a blue T-shirt calmly keeps eating cereal from a bowl, and a tabby cat sleeps on the windowsill beside a potted herb. A pink morning sky shows above the train.

phrases.en: to stare at the passing train

5637.question: What is the woman staring at?
5637.answer: She is staring at the passing train.

5638.about: In a warm living room in the evening, a young woman in a red long-sleeved top and cream wide trousers smiles as she presses a drinking glass over a big spider on the white wall and slides a sheet of paper under it, talking calmly. Behind her a young man in a green hoodie and a young woman in a pink slip dress stand on the mustard sofa, holding on to each other, then climb down and watch nervously from behind her. Cushions lie on the floor, and a shelf with potted plants hangs above.

phrases.en: to wear a pink slip dress
to hold a sheet of paper

5638.question: What is the woman in red doing?
5638.answer: She is trapping a spider with a glass.

5640.about: On a rocky mountain summit at sunrise, high above a sea of clouds, a young woman in a coral sports top and black leggings sits barefoot on the rock and raises both fists in triumph, while a young man in a navy vest and beige shorts lies back on the rock laughing with his arms spread. She lowers her arms, smiles at him and then lies back on the rock too. Hiking boots, socks, a water bottle, trekking poles and backpacks lie in front, and a wild goat stands on the rocks to the right.

phrases.en: to stand on a rocky ledge

5640.question: What is the man doing?
5640.answer: He is spreading his arms wide.

5641.about: On a rainy street in the evening, in front of dark stone buildings with pointed arches and balconies, a young woman in a burgundy leather jacket and a black skirt laughs, staying dry under a sturdy navy umbrella with a curved wooden handle. Beside her a young man in a soaked light blue shirt holds up a cheap black umbrella blown inside out, its thin spokes bent, looks up at it and pulls a face. The wet pavement reflects the street lamps, and a black and yellow taxi is parked behind them.
5641.question: What is the man holding?
5641.answer: He is holding an inside-out umbrella.

5643.about: A young bearded man in a brown canvas apron over a beige T-shirt stands in a sunlit woodworking workshop, clasps his hands together at his chest, leans forward and keeps pleading with a young woman with a canvas bag on her shoulder who stands by the open door facing him. Tools hang above a workbench and sawdust covers the floor. Outside in the yard, a man pushes a trolley stacked with wooden crates and a woman in an apron watches.
5643.question: What is the man in front doing?

5644.about: On a narrow cobbled street between white colonial houses with green wooden balconies and red geraniums, a young man in a paint-splattered white T-shirt and jeans stands on an aluminium ladder and rolls one bright blue stripe across a bare white wall, then pushes the roller up and down so the stripe grows into a long bent line, the paint dripping down. A young woman in a rust top and black trousers holds the ladder and smiles up at him. Paint tins and a tray sit on a dust sheet below.

phrases.en: to paint a bold blue stripe

5644.question: What is the man doing?
5644.answer: He is painting a bold blue stripe.

5645.about: A quiet library reading room is seen through a doorway framed by bookshelves, and the view moves into the room. A young woman with long curly dark hair, in a beige knitted top and trousers, rides a wooden book trolley down the aisle with her arms flung up, shouting with joy, while books lie scattered on the herringbone floor. Students at long desks with green lamps turn and stare at her, and a man in a suit appears behind her. A sign asking for silence hangs in front of tall shelves.
5645.question: What is the curly-haired woman doing?
5645.answer: She is riding on a book cart.

5646.about: On the covered deck of a wooden houseboat on a calm river at sunset, a young woman in a rust top and cream trousers lies back barefoot on a cushioned bench against a young man in a white linen shirt, who wraps his arms around her; they smile and look into each other's eyes the whole time. A brass lantern hangs from the woven roof and a kingfisher perches on the railing. Palm trees and green fields line the far bank under a pink and orange sky.

phrases.en: to hang from the thatched roof

5646.question: What is the man doing?
5646.answer: He is embracing her from behind.

5647.about: On a cobbled village street in warm evening light, a young woman in a cream shirt and jeans crouches and holds the face of a big shaggy grey dog, smiling as it leans into her. An older man in a baker's apron steps out of a stone doorway and holds out a piece of bread to the dog, a woman behind him holds a wooden crate, and a bearded man on a ladder leans down to look. Food bowls stand on the pavement and more villagers stand further along the street.

phrases.en: to lean down from a ladder

5647.question: What is the young woman doing?
5647.answer: She is cradling the dog's face.

5648.about: In a gym hall with a wooden floor and high windows, a young man in a sweat-soaked grey vest and black shorts climbs a thick hanging rope near the ceiling beams, pulling himself up hand over hand with his legs wrapped around the rope, gritting his teeth and then grinning. Far below, a young man in black and a young woman in a grey top and black leggings hold on to two other ropes, start to climb and look up at him. Blue crash mats, boxes and a bowl of chalk sit along the wall.
5648.question: What is the man up high doing?
5648.answer: He is climbing near the ceiling.

5649.about: At a skatepark at sunset, a young man in a white vest and black shorts stands on top of a three-step concrete block like a winner's podium, one fist raised and a skateboard held high, shouting with joy, then lifts the skateboard over his head with both hands. On the lower left step a young man in a blue T-shirt claps, and on the right step a young woman in a mustard top pats his leg. Skateboards and a water bottle lie on the ground, with palm trees and a clear blue sky.
5649.question: What is the man in blue doing?

5650.about: At an outdoor skatepark in the evening, a young man in a rust T-shirt and jeans, one foot on a skateboard, laughs and shakes hands with a young woman with a blonde ponytail in a light blue crop top and matching trousers, her other hand on her hip. He points at a long flight of concrete stairs with a metal handrail, and after the handshake she points at him and then at the stairs, laughing. A few banknotes lie on the concrete ledge beside them. Other skaters stand at the top of the stairs.
5650.question: What is the man pointing at?
5650.answer: He is pointing at the staircase.

5651.about: In a bright barber shop, a young female barber in a white T-shirt and apron holds a comb and smiles. Beside her a young man in a cutting cape sits in a black barber chair, touches his messy hair and pulls a worried face with his mouth open, while the barber looks at her comb and laughs. On the left another young man in a blue T-shirt and cape smiles and looks down at his neat, short new haircut. Cut hair lies on the wooden floor and a ginger cat sleeps on a cat tree by the window.
5651.question: What is the cat doing?
5651.answer: It is sleeping by the window.

5653.about: On a country show field in golden afternoon light, a young woman in an olive tank top, tan work trousers, boots and work gloves kneels on the grass and pushes a huge orange pumpkin onto a wooden pallet next to a much smaller pumpkin. Then she stands up, steps back and smiles at it, surprised and proud. Older people stand behind a rope watching, next to a chalkboard with a list. A striped marquee, a table of smaller pumpkins and a wheelbarrow fill the background.

phrases.en: to tower over a small pumpkin

5653.question: What is the woman doing?
5653.answer: She is pushing a giant pumpkin onto a pallet.

5654.about: On an athletics podium on the grass of a floodlit stadium at dusk, a young woman in a navy crop top and briefs, her long braids in a ponytail, stands on the lower step with her arms crossed and a silver medal on her chest, scowling and looking away. On the higher step a young woman in white smiles and raises a gold medal high above her head, holding a bouquet. The view moves closer to the scowling woman until her angry face fills most of the view. Empty stands and bright floodlights are behind.
5654.question: How does the woman in blue feel?
5654.answer: She feels bitter about her silver medal.

5655.about: Inside a launderette with a black and white checked floor, turquoise and pink tiles and neon lights, a tall chestnut horse with a halter and a long lead rope stands holding a striped sock in its mouth. Next to it a young woman with curly hair in a pink top and denim shorts bends over by an open washing machine, pulls out a white towel and laughs, looking at the horse. The view moves back from the horse's head to show the whole room with its orange plastic chairs and a potted plant.
5655.question: What is the horse carrying?
5655.answer: The horse is carrying a striped sock.

5657.about: In a harbour with colourful wooden fishing boats in front of a honey-coloured church with two bell towers, a young priest in a white robe over a black cassock stands on the stone quay, raises a metal sprinkler and splashes water toward a young woman in a yellow jacket and rubber boots. She stands on a blue and yellow boat with her head bowed and her hands pressed together, then looks up and smiles at him with a hand on her chest as he lowers the sprinkler. Orange nets and ropes lie on the boat.
5657.question: What is the priest doing?
5657.answer: He is blessing the woman on the boat.

5658.about: In a busy restaurant kitchen, a young head chef in a white jacket tastes a spoonful from a plate of seared scallops on yellow purée and gives an approving smile. Beside him a young cook in a navy apron pumps both fists in the air and laughs with relief. The chef lowers the spoon, smiles at the plate and slides it toward the cook, who claps his hands together, beaming. Copper pans hang on a rail, green pendant lamps light cream tiles, and other cooks work in the background.

phrases.en: to punch the air with joy

5658.question: What is the cook in blue doing?
5658.answer: He is punching the air with joy.

5659.about: At a café window seat, a young blonde woman in a white sleeveless top and a black skirt sits on a stool at the wooden counter, calmly taps on her phone, then puts it face down on the counter, turns away and picks up a croissant. Outside, on the other side of the glass, a man with curly hair in a blue denim shirt holds up his own phone, waves and then stands frowning at her. A cappuccino, a croissant and a second phone sit on the counter, plants hang in the window and people sit at a table behind her.
5659.question: What is the man outside doing?

5662.about: In a restaurant kitchen, a blender full of red tomato sauce bursts and sprays a young man in a white vest and a cream apron. He throws up his hands in shock, wipes his face and then stands still at the counter, his face, shoulder and arm dripping with bright red sauce, looking fed up. Red splashes cover the white tiles and the steel counter. A young woman in a black top and apron stands behind him, smiling and holding the blender's clear lid. Jars of spices sit on a shelf above.

phrases.en: to wipe sauce off his face

5662.question: What is the man covered in?
5662.answer: He is covered in tomato sauce.

5663.about: In a gym with bare brick walls and a big window, a young man in a grey vest, blue shorts and grey hand wraps throws a hard punch into a large brown leather punching bag hanging on chains, and a puff of dust bursts out where his fist hits it. He pulls back his fist and moves around in a fighting stance, ready for the next punch. On the other side a young man in a cream vest holds the swinging bag steady. A skipping rope and a white water bottle lie on the floor mats.
5663.question: What is the man in grey doing?

5664.about: In a cosy living room in the evening, three young friends sit on a sofa around a wooden coffee table covered by a colourful board game with a map board, small wooden pieces and cards. A young woman with long braids in a lilac top and denim shorts watches the board, then jumps up and throws her arms in the air, cheering. A young man in a white polo shirt laughs and moves a piece on the board, and a young woman in a cream cardigan watches. A shelf of game boxes, a floor lamp and a tabby cat are around them.
5664.question: What are the three friends doing?
5664.answer: They are playing a board game.

5665.about: On a misty cliff top at sunrise, a young woman in a climbing harness, a grey jacket, khaki trousers and black boots walks across a narrow wooden plank bridge hung on cables over a deep drop, holding a guide rope with one hand. She laughs, looks back once and keeps stepping forward from plank to plank toward the rock. A group of young people on a rocky ledge behind her watch, some crouching with ropes. Coiled ropes and metal anchor bolts lie on the rock in the foreground.
5665.question: What is the climber doing?
5665.answer: She is walking along a narrow plank.

5667.about: In a small comedy club lit by a spotlight, a comedian bends forward on the stage near a microphone stand. In the audience a young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt stands up from his table, cups one hand at his mouth to shout and raises his other hand with the thumb pointing down, while a man behind him holds up two thumbs down. A paper plane flies through the beam of light and falls to the floor. A waitress walks between small wooden tables with beers on them.
5667.question: What is the man in orange doing?
5667.answer: He is booing the comedian on stage.

5668.about: A restaurant entrance is seen over the shoulder of a man in a black shirt. A young hostess in a burgundy cropped jumper and black skirt stands by a wooden host stand and smiles as she points across the room to a set table by the window, where a waiter in a white shirt pulls out a chair. Then she walks back to the stand and runs her finger down the open reservations book, where another hand holds a pen. Tulips in vases, a green velvet bench and pendant lamps fill the room.
5668.question: Where is the woman pointing?
5668.answer: She is pointing at a table by the window.

5669.about: In an elegant restaurant in the evening, a bearded man in a black shirt stands at the glass door and spreads his hands apologetically toward a young couple: a woman with braids in a burgundy blouse and black skirt, and a man in a cream jumper. The couple turn and walk away past him while he presses his hands together. Every table is set with white cloths, candles, water carafes and glasses. Waiters in white shirts work near a stack of plates, and round paper lanterns hang from the dark wooden ceiling.

phrases.en: to reach for the door handle
phrases.target: the man in the cream jumper

5669.question: What is the man in black doing?
5669.answer: He is pressing his palms together.

5670.about: In an old seaside dance hall with tall arched windows and string lights across the ceiling, a man in a cream linen suit and tie shakes hands with a young woman with curly hair in a green satin top and black wide trousers, holding up two fingers with his other hand; both smile. Then she lets go, turns and walks happily toward the stage, waving him along. Behind them musicians set up: a woman with a double bass and another woman with a drum. A roller door stands open onto a boardwalk.

phrases.en: to wear a green satin top

phrases.target: the musician with the double bass

5670.question: What are the man and woman doing?
5670.answer: They are shaking hands in a spacious hall.

5672.about: In a plain classroom with tall windows, a teacher in a white shirt points at circles drawn on a whiteboard. At a wooden desk a young woman in a cream knitted jumper rests her cheek on her hand with half-closed eyes, slowly falls asleep with her head on the desk, jerks up wide awake, then props her chin on her hands and closes her eyes again. Behind her a young man in a navy T-shirt sleeps with his head on his arms. A paper coffee cup and an open empty notebook with a pen lie on the desks.

phrases.en: to wear a dark blue T-shirt

5672.question: What is the young man doing?
5672.answer: He is sleeping at his desk.

5674.about: At a picnic in the desert at sunset, a young woman with long curly dark hair, in a rust shirt tied at the waist and white linen trousers, sits on a woven blanket on the sand, frowning and waving her hand at a small fly buzzing around her face while she holds a sandwich in her other hand. She shuts her eyes, blows at the fly, then turns and complains with an annoyed face as it flies off. A steel flask and a bowl of dates sit on the blanket, with sand dunes and a golden sky behind.
5674.question: What is bothering the woman?

5675.about: On the sunny wooden deck of a sailing yacht, a young man in a navy linen shirt and white trousers sits on a folding wooden chair, tied to it with many loops of pink ribbon around his chest and arms, and laughs. A young woman in a yellow sundress ties a big pink bow on top of his head, while a young woman in a red swimsuit and white shirt pulls more ribbon tight around him. Rolls of pink ribbon lie on the deck, with the mast, steel rails and blue sea behind.

phrases.en: to sit bound to a chair
to tie a big pink bow

5675.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?
5675.answer: She is tying a bow on his head.

5677.about: In a retro bowling alley with teal walls, red panels and neon lights, a young woman with a long blonde braid, in a red cropped jacket and cream trousers, throws both arms up in celebration as her ball crashes into the white pins at the end of the shiny wooden lane and knocks them down. In the foreground another person's arm points down the lane. Then she lowers her arms, turns around and looks back with an open mouth and a surprised smile.

phrases.en: to raise both arms in triumph

5677.question: What is the woman doing?
5677.answer: She is raising both arms in triumph.

5678.about: In a pink living room in a curved retro style, a young woman in a pink satin robe sits on a green velvet sofa painting her toenails, then sits back and stretches her arms up. A young man in a navy overcoat and suit stands by the wooden front door holding a scarf, checks his watch with a frown and lifts his hand as he gets ready to leave. A Siamese cat lies on the sofa, and a coffee table holds nail polish bottles and cotton balls.

phrases.en: to lie on the velvet sofa

5678.question: What is the man doing?
5678.answer: He is frowning at his watch.

5679.about: In a work yard at dusk, a young woman in a tan work jacket and trousers, her braided hair in a bun, places her hand gently on the arm of a young man in a dark zip jumper who holds an empty wooden crate. She speaks to him seriously, lifts a white paper and shows it to him, and he turns from her face to the paper with a shocked look. Workers in yellow high-visibility vests stand near metal sheds, a street lamp glows and the sky is deep blue.
5679.question: What is the man holding?
5679.answer: He is holding an empty wooden crate.

5680.about: In a traditional Chinese garden pavilion, a young woman in a lilac satin wrap top and cream trousers suddenly bursts out laughing, covers her mouth with her hand, laughs harder with her head thrown back and finally bends over wiping her eyes. Behind her a young man in a black traditional jacket kneels very seriously at a low rosewood table, pouring tea from a small clay teapot into white cups, while a mallard duck stands on the table beside him. A red lantern and a round moon gate with bamboo are behind them.

phrases.en: to kneel at the tea table

5680.question: What is the woman doing?

5681.about: On a lit-up disco floor of bright pink, orange and blue squares, a young woman in a gold sequin crop top and white flared trousers dances close up with her arms raised. As the view moves back, four young women in the same gold tops, white trousers and gold heels appear, but their routine has fallen apart: each one moves in a different direction and at a different moment, one throws her arms up, one reaches sideways and one stands still. A mirror ball and a ring of silver spotlights hang above.

phrases.en: to extend her arm straight out
phrases.target: the woman on the far left

5681.question: What is the curly-haired woman doing?

5682.about: In clear blue sea, a young woman with long dark hair, in a blue bikini top, black board shorts and fins, floats upright beside a rope with a weight hanging from it and slowly blows a long stream of silver bubbles from her mouth that rise toward the bright rippling surface. Her eyes close, her fins move gently and she brings one hand to her chest. A single fish swims past on the right, and a pale sandy seabed lies below her in the deep blue water.
5682.question: What is the woman doing?
5682.answer: She is blowing a stream of bubbles.

5683.about: In a dim, old-style bar during an evening of short dates, a young woman with curly hair in a green satin blouse and black skirt laughs with her chin on her hand, talking to a young man in a dark blazer and white shirt. He laughs, takes off his blazer and leans back, throwing his head back. On their small marble table an hourglass runs, its sand almost gone. Behind them other couples sit at small round tables lit by green banker's lamps. Two glasses of lemonade stand in the foreground.
5683.question: What is the man doing?

5685.about: On an ice rink in a packed arena, a young male figure skater in a black top and trousers bows deeply in the middle of the ice while red roses fly through the air and land around him. He straightens up, turns his back and spreads his arms wide toward the crowd. Behind the white barrier a large crowd stands and claps, some holding scarves and flags, under bright ceiling lights. Red roses lie scattered on the ice around his skates.
5685.question: What is the man doing?
5685.answer: He is bowing to the crowd.

5686.about: In a sunny stone courtyard under a grapevine pergola, a young woman with curly hair in a lilac cropped jumper and black trousers holds a small brown puppy and gives a half-reluctant smile. A young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt and beige trousers reaches out, scratches the puppy's chin and leans in close to it. She softens, laughs and lifts the puppy up happily as he smiles. A metal water bowl and a striped blanket lie on the flagstones by a blue wooden door.

phrases.en: to lean in towards the puppy

5686.question: What is the man doing?
5686.answer: He is scratching the puppy's chin.

5687.about: In a busy street market at night under strings of lights, the pavement wet from rain, a young woman in an olive cycling top and shorts leans from her cargo bike and hands a wooden crate full of steaming fresh loaves toward a bread stall. She gets off the bike, carries the crate to the counter, sets it down and talks to the people in front of the stall, smiling. Wicker baskets, a chalkboard price list and a warm-lit counter stand at the stall, and a small crowd watches.

phrases.en: to get off her cargo bike

5687.question: What is the cyclist doing?

5689.about: A young man with black hair, in a rust-red jumper and big headphones, sits in a small wood-panelled radio studio at dusk. He smiles, talks into a silver microphone on a studio arm and moves the sliders of a large mixing desk with one hand. Then he leans back from the desk and lifts a hand to his headphones. A red light glows above the door, vinyl records and a glass of water stand beside him, and a red and white radio mast rises outside the window.
5689.question: What is the man doing?
5689.answer: He is speaking into a microphone.

5691.about: A young woman with curly dark hair and gold hoop earrings, in a lilac knitted top and a cream skirt, takes a mirror selfie with her phone. A grey parrot with a red tail stands on her shoulder and keeps flapping its wings next to her face. She frowns, squints and pushes her hand towards it, then lowers the phone, rubs her forehead and looks annoyed. The room has mint-green walls, blue wooden shutters, a cane chair with clothes, a bird perch and an amber chandelier.
5691.question: What is the parrot doing?
5691.answer: It is flapping its wings next to her face.

5695.about: Seen from the back of an open safari jeep, a driver's hands rest on a padded roll bar. Ahead, a kudu antelope with long spiral horns and white stripes on its brown coat walks across the sandy track, kicking up a little dust, then stops at the edge and turns its head. Wild land of thorny shrubs, low green trees and a red termite mound stretches to the horizon with no buildings, a dry sandy riverbed winds through it, and heavy grey clouds fill the sky.

phrases.target: the man in the red shirt

phrases.en: to pause by the thorny shrubs

5695.question: What is the antelope doing?
5695.answer: It is crossing the sandy track.

5696.about: In a small flower shop full of buckets of fresh flowers and hanging plants, a smiling young woman with her hair in a bun, in a maroon top and a long cream apron, hands a big bouquet in brown paper across a wooden work table to a young customer in a lilac T-shirt and wide jeans, who gives her a banknote. The customer then holds the bouquet to her chest and smiles. Behind them a young man in an apron works at the table, rolls of ribbon hang on it and a dog sleeps underneath.

phrases.target: the woman in the red top

5696.question: What is the girl in jeans buying?

5697.about: Under the glass roof of an outdoor flower market at dusk, on wet pavement, a young woman with sunglasses on her head, in a camel jacket and dark jeans, holds out a banknote to a stallholder and takes a large bunch of pink and red dahlias. She hugs the flowers to her chest and walks away towards the camera, smiling. Metal buckets of flowers stand on the ground and hang above, hanging scales dangle from the stall roof, rolls of wrapping paper are fixed to the counter and a woman waits behind her.

phrases.en: to hug a bunch of dahlias

5697.question: What is the dark-haired woman doing?
5697.answer: She is buying a bunch of dahlias.

5698.about: On an outdoor basketball court with a blue surface and a green metal fence at dusk, a young man in a blue sleeveless top and black shorts, seen from behind, holds the ball above his head. A young woman with long curly hair, in a red crop top and black shorts, stretches one arm high with her mouth open, shouting for the ball. She then runs up close to him and raises both arms high while he keeps the ball above his head. Two young men stand watching by the fence.

phrases.en: to try to block his shot

5698.question: What is the woman doing?
5698.answer: She is calling for the ball.

5699.about: On a sandy beach at sunset under a pink and orange sky, a tall young man in a black T-shirt and white shorts stretches one arm out and waves someone over. A smiling young woman in a mustard top and navy track trousers comes towards him barefoot, pulling on her jacket. He turns and points towards the game, and she walks after him with the jacket in her hand. People play football by the sea behind them, a brightly painted wooden boat lies on the sand and a white wall with a lamp post runs along the right.
5699.question: What is the man doing?

5700.about: On the front porch of a red wooden house at night, under a dark sky with a crescent moon, a young woman with long dark wavy hair, in a rust-coloured zip jacket and black cycling shorts, stands in the open white doorway and talks, then raises a fist. A young man with a beard, in a green knitted jumper, stands on the wooden deck beside a bicycle with a wicker basket and looks at her. A small brown and white dog walks out between them. A lantern glows on the wall and a pot of pink flowers sits by the step.
5700.question: What is the man doing?

5701.about: High on a steep red-tiled roof above a sea bay, under dark storm clouds with sunlight breaking through, a young woman with curly hair tied back, in a dark work jacket and a safety harness, kneels on the tiles. She stretches out an arm with a grey slate, turns her head and shouts out loud with her mouth wide open. A rope from a hoist hangs on the right, and two men in dark work clothes stand on the bare wooden roof battens below, holding slates. Green headlands line the coast.

phrases.en: to kneel on the steep roof

5701.question: What is the woman doing?
5701.answer: She is calling out from the roof.

5702.about: Under a covered arcade with pastel green and pink walls, arches and glowing red paper lanterns at dusk, a young man in a dark bomber jacket and beige trousers stands with his eyes squeezed shut and his arms at his sides. A young woman in a blue jacket and black trousers rests her hands on his shoulder. He breathes out slowly through his mouth, tips his head back, then opens his eyes and stands calmly as she steps back. A cream-coloured scooter lies on its side on the tiled floor beside them.
5702.question: What is the man doing?

5703.about: In a living room in the evening with dark green walls, a green tiled stove, tall windows and a brass pendant lamp, a young woman with long braids, in pink pyjamas, sits on a rust-coloured velvet sofa under a cream knitted blanket and eats ice cream from a tub with a spoon. Her friend, dressed to go out in a sequined top, a black leather skirt and heels, with a small gold bag, stands beside the sofa, throws her hands out in disbelief and talks to her, then lets her arms drop. A candle burns on the table.

phrases.en: to dig into her ice cream

phrases.target: the woman in the sequined top

5703.question: What is the woman in pyjamas doing?
5703.answer: She is digging into her ice cream.

5704.about: On a rooftop building site at dusk with lit skyscrapers all around, a young woman in a blue and maroon superhero suit with a mask, a flowing cape and tall boots holds up a huge steel beam above her head. She rises from a crouch, pushes the beam up with one arm, then with both hands, and loose bolts fall from it onto the wooden deck. A crane hook hangs nearby, and construction workers in orange hard hats walk calmly across the roof behind her, carrying bags.

phrases.en: to hold up a steel beam

5704.question: What is the superhero doing?
5704.answer: She is lifting a huge steel beam.

5705.about: In a long underground car park with a low concrete ceiling, bright strip lights and rows of white pillars, a young woman with a long red ponytail, in a black cropped jacket and black skirt, stands in the driving lane holding her car key high above her head and looks around. She lowers her arm, turns and walks away down the lane between cars parked in marked bays. A car with its headlights on waits at the far end, and a tabby cat sits on the bonnet of a parked car on the right.

phrases.en: to hold up her car key

5705.question: What is the woman doing?
5705.answer: She is walking between the cars.

5706.about: Three young friends play cards at a table on a moving train, fields passing outside the window. A young woman with long dark hair, in a mustard top and wide jeans, throws one arm up in triumph and laughs, then puts her hand back on the table. Across from her a young man in a navy shirt holds a fan of cards and rolls his eyes up. A young woman with a red ponytail, in a green T-shirt, stands at the table holding her cards. Paper coffee cups and a pile of cards sit on the table, and a brown and white spaniel lies underneath.

phrases.en: to raise her arm in triumph

5706.question: What is the man doing?

5707.about: Beside a calm lake with pine trees and a wooden cabin, in warm evening light, a young man with a short beard, in a loose white linen shirt and light trousers, holds a big tortoise against his chest with one arm. He feeds it a red strawberry, looks at it fondly as it chews, then offers it another strawberry. A bowl of strawberries sits on a wooden picnic table in front, and a raised flower bed full of colourful flowers and a metal watering can stand behind him.
5707.question: What is the man doing?
5707.answer: He is feeding strawberries to the tortoise.

5708.about: In a supermarket car park at dusk in heavy rain, the wet tarmac shining under street lamps, a young woman in a grey sweatshirt and jeans crouches and holds her open black coat out wide over a small wet shaggy dog. She wraps the coat around the dog, picks it up and walks towards the camera, hugging it to her chest. A shopping trolley with a carrier bag stands behind her, and a middle-aged woman, an older man and a man in a hooded jacket stand watching in front of the brightly lit shop.
5708.question: What is the young woman doing?
5708.answer: She is hugging the wet dog to her chest.

5711.about: At a wildlife rescue centre in soft golden evening light, a smiling young man in a green work shirt and white trousers feeds a baby elephant from a big plastic milk bottle and strokes its back. The little elephant wears a red and green checked blanket, swings its trunk and drinks, milk dripping from its mouth. The man then bends down and rests his head against the elephant's head while it curls its trunk up over him. A fence of rough wooden poles, a tin-roofed shelter and acacia trees stand around them on the red earth.

phrases.en: to guzzle milk from a bottle

5711.question: What is the man doing?
5711.answer: He is bottle-feeding a baby elephant.

5714.about: In a quiet forest cemetery at sunrise, rows of plain square grey stone grave markers stand among tall straight pine trees on frosty, mossy grass, fading into pink morning mist. A red squirrel with tufted ears sits on top of one of the stones, nibbling a pine cone held in its front paws, with bits of cone on the ground below. It then leaps down, runs across the grass and settles on a stone again, eating. The light is soft and cold, and the scene is calm.
5714.question: What is the squirrel doing?
5714.answer: The squirrel is nibbling a pine cone.

5715.about: In an old underground office inside an arched stone tunnel lit by green desk lamps, a young woman with her hair pinned up in an old-fashioned style, in a green blouse and navy skirt, sits at a riveted metal desk. She lays a metal ruler across a handwritten letter on a glass sheet and runs a small blade along it to cut out a line, then sits back and smiles. Stacks of envelopes sit on the desk, a wire basket below is full of cut paper strips, and another woman works at a desk behind her.
5715.question: What is the woman in front doing?
5715.answer: She is cutting a letter with a blade.

5716.about: On a snowy shore in Antarctica on a clear, sunny day, with white icebergs floating on the dark blue sea behind, a young woman in a yellow beanie, a red padded jacket, black trousers and gloves stands beside her backpack. A line of gentoo penguins with black backs, white bellies and orange beaks waddles past her one by one, and she points at each of them, counting, then lowers her arm. Further along the shore people in red and dark jackets work beside a white box, and footprints cover the snow.

phrases.en: to point at the passing penguins

5716.question: What is the woman doing?
5716.answer: She is counting the penguins on the shore.

5717.about: In the sandy arena of a huge ancient stone amphitheatre, with rows of golden arches and stone seats curving all around under a pale blue sky with thin clouds, a young woman with curly dark hair, in a mustard blouse, a flowing white skirt and sandals, spins round and round with her arms out, laughing, her skirt swirling. She stays right in the middle of the empty arena, inside a large circle drawn in the sand, and small birds fly high above the walls.
5717.question: What is the woman doing?
5717.answer: She is spinning in the center.

5718.about: In a bright office with big windows, pendant lamps and potted plants, three young colleagues play a wooden block-stacking game. A young man in a blue shirt pulls a block out of the middle of the tall tower, which wobbles and leans, then settles upright again. He holds up the block and grins. A young man in a green T-shirt crouches and holds the base steady on a book, and a young woman in a maroon jumper gasps with her mouth open and her hands raised. Coffee mugs and pens lie on the table in front.

phrases.en: to raise both hands in alarm

5718.question: What is the woman doing?
5718.answer: She is raising both hands in alarm.

5719.about: In an elegant old office with wooden cabinets, a checked black and white floor, green banker's lamps and a crystal chandelier, an official in a dark jacket and gold watch presses a heavy brass embossing seal onto a cream certificate with a gold seal and a red ribbon on a round walnut desk. A smiling young woman with long black hair, in a green cardigan, sits across the desk with her chin on her hands, watching. The official then lifts the certificate and holds it up to her, and she looks at it in delight.
5719.question: What is the young woman doing?

6814.about: A laughing young woman in a yellow raincoat, a striped top, rolled jeans and a straw hat rides a bicycle along a wet stone causeway, holding her hat on with one hand. Her wheels splash through sea water as she rides, and waves break on both sides. Behind her a big old grey stone abbey church with a tall square bell tower, arched windows and slate roofs stands on a rocky island with a green walled garden. Gulls fly under a heavy grey sky.

phrases.en: to stand on a rocky island

6814.question: What is the woman doing?
6814.answer: She is riding a bicycle along a causeway.

6815.about: In a sunny town square at a lemon festival, a young woman in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue rubber gloves squeezes a lemon above her head over a long paper test strip. The strip turns from blue to bright red, and she shouts with joy as the crowd in summer clothes cheers, claps and films with phones. On a table beside her a bowl of white powder foams over next to a glass of juice. Behind the crowd rise a giant lion and a ship built from lemons and oranges under yellow bunting.

phrases.target: the woman in the lab coat

6815.question: What is the woman in goggles doing?
6815.answer: She is squeezing half a lemon.

6816.about: On the small stage of a basement theatre with brick walls and string lights, a young woman in a black polo neck and trousers sits on a wooden chair and leans far back with wide eyes and flying hair, as if caught in a storm. A man holds an electric fan towards her and a woman on a ladder pours water from a watering can, while a man plays an upright piano. She then sits up and shades her eyes with one hand, looking into the distance. The audience in the front rows laughs and covers their faces.
6816.question: What is the actress doing?
6816.answer: She is acting out a storm on stage.

6817.about: On a big steel bridge on a misty morning, a young woman in an orange jacket and green headscarf sits cross-legged on the wet road and shouts into a megaphone, one arm locked into a painted tube joining her to the next person. Other young protesters in warm hats sit in a line across the lanes under a flag with a burning globe. She leans forward and keeps shouting, then lowers the megaphone and stares straight ahead in silence. A police officer in a yellow vest stands behind her, and lorries wait with their lights on.
6817.question: What is the activist doing?
6817.answer: She is shouting into a megaphone.

6818.about: In a busy old-fashioned office with tall windows, wooden desks, typewriters, rotary phones and an old computer, a young man in a light blue shirt, tie and grey trousers rolls along the wooden floor on red roller skates, carrying a tall stack of ring binders. He sways and kicks one skate out as he moves, and a loose sheet falls to the floor. Colleagues at every desk wave folders and documents at him, calling for his attention, and an open filing cabinet drawer stands beside him.
6818.question: What is the administrator doing?
6818.answer: He is skating across the office.

6819.about: On the rainy deck of a navy ship in a harbour, an older woman in a long dark navy coat with gold buttons, thick gold stripes on the sleeves and a white-topped peaked cap stands on a wooden step, raises her hand and salutes. She holds the salute, then drops her arm and speaks. Behind her a line of young sailors in dark uniforms and white caps stands to attention, one of them saluting, and an officer in a raincoat watches. A flag flies from a mast above them and a small tugboat waits on the grey water.
6819.question: Where is the admiral standing?
6819.answer: She is standing on a wooden platform.

6821.about: In an elegant restaurant in the evening, with chandeliers, candles, white tablecloths and tall arched windows over a river, a young woman in a green silk dress looks down into her open brown wallet with a nervous smile. A man in a velvet jacket points happily at the menu while a waiter pours champagne. She closes the wallet in her lap and looks up as a waiter brings a tall three-level tray of lobster, crabs and oysters to the table, and she smiles. A violinist plays behind them.
6821.question: What is the waiter bringing?
6821.answer: He is bringing a huge seafood platter.

6823.about: In a narrow stone street of a seaside town after a big storm, a wooden fishing boat with a tall mast lies stranded in the road next to a parked car, hung with seaweed, while seagulls fly around it. Seaweed, white crates and rubbish cover the wet road, and water gushes out of a doorway onto the pavement and slowly stops. A young woman in a jumper and green wellies holds a broom by a shop door and stares up at the boat with her mouth open. Further down, two men stand in the street near a black dog and an armchair.
6823.question: What is the woman staring at?
6823.answer: She is staring at a stranded boat.

6825.about: At an old wooden chalet in a sunny mountain village, a smiling young woman in a white shirt leans out over an upstairs balcony rail and shakes a big white duvet out into the fresh air, flapping it up and down and laughing. Pillows hang on the wall beside her, a striped rug hangs on the rail next to red geraniums, and below, an older woman in a striped cardigan arranges pillows while a cat sits beside her. A church tower with an onion dome and snowy peaks rise in the background.
6825.question: What is the young woman doing?
6825.answer: She is shaking a duvet over the balcony.

6826.about: On a whitewashed terrace above the sea in soft evening light, a light wind blows the long white curtains of the doorway out into the air. Pink petals float past and a straw hat rolls across the stone floor. A young man in an open white shirt lies on a built-in bench with a blue cushion, a book in his hand, and smiles as the breeze moves his hair. A shell wind chime sways, a young woman leans on the white wall by a domed chapel, and a cat walks past a table with a water jug.
6826.question: What is the man doing?
6826.answer: He is lounging on a blue cushion.

6827.about: In a small bedroom in bright morning light, a young woman with messy blonde hair and a white T-shirt lies asleep on a white pillow. Beside the bed a round silver alarm clock with two bells stands on a wooden chair used as a bedside table, on a newspaper next to a book and a glass of water. She lifts her head, sits up half-asleep and swings her arm down towards the clock, knocking the book off, then drops back onto the pillow and sleeps again. A chest of drawers and a window with thin curtains are behind her.

phrases.en: to sleep on a white pillow

6827.question: What is the woman doing?
6827.answer: She is sleeping on a white pillow.

6828.about: In a narrow corridor of an industrial building filled with flashing red light and a little smoke, a big round red alarm bell and red warning lamps glow on the white wall. A young woman in a white hard hat, navy overalls and a yellow high-visibility vest walks along the corridor towards them, then stops, stretches out her arms and shouts, directing a line of workers in hard hats and overalls who hurry along behind her. One worker carries a clipboard, and a fire extinguisher hangs on the wall.

phrases.en: to lead a line of workers

6828.question: What is the woman doing?
6828.answer: She is spreading her arms wide.

6829.about: In a crowded street market in an Asian city in late afternoon light, a young woman with long blonde hair, a loose white shirt, beige trousers and sandals stands with a wheeled suitcase and an open guidebook. She looks up and around at the signs in a foreign script, then down at her book and around again as a motor scooter passes behind her. A stallholder hands a paper bag across a food cart, and paper lanterns, cycle rickshaws and tangled overhead cables fill the busy street.

phrases.en: to gaze up at the signs
to hand over a paper bag

6829.question: What is the blonde woman doing?

6830.about: In a large open boat workshop with a corrugated roof, the shiny, silvery metal hull of a new boat hangs from ropes above a rusty steel cradle and slowly turns as it is lowered. Workers in hard hats and yellow or orange high-visibility clothes hold the ropes and guide it from below. Coils of silver wire stand in the foreground, a forklift waits behind, and the sea and a quay are visible through the wide open doors.

phrases.en: to turn slowly in the air
to stand idle by the doors

6830.question: What is the boat hull doing?
6830.answer: The hull is hanging from ropes.
